likelyErrorScenarios.description: Card issuer declined the transaction. CardServ returns orderState=DECLINED with an errorCode and errorMessage. The user is redirected to /payment-failed.
likelyErrorScenarios.evidenceNeeded: Check PaymentOrder.gatewayResponse in MongoDB for these orderMerchantIds

likelyErrorScenarios.description: CardServ fraud filters blocked the transaction (IP mismatch, high-risk card, velocity check). Returns orderState=FILTERED.
likelyErrorScenarios.notes: Two orders 11 minutes apart from same user may trigger velocity filters

likelyErrorScenarios.description: User was redirected to 3DS verification page but did not complete it, or the result callback failed to extract orderMerchantId from the 3DS redirect.
likelyErrorScenarios.notes: The extractOrderMerchantId function checks: path segment, MD form field, threeDSSessionData, query params. If none match, order stays stuck in PROCESSING.

likelyErrorScenarios.description: CardServ completed the transaction but webhook to /api/cardserv/webhook was never delivered (network issue, wrong webhookUrl, server down). Order remains in PENDING/PROCESSING and tokens are never credited.
likelyErrorScenarios.notes: No automatic cleanup exists for stale PENDING orders. webhookUrl is built from getAppUrl() which may differ between environments.

likelyErrorScenarios.description: Amount sent to CardServ in EUR may not match what user expected due to hardcoded exchange rates (GBP: 1.0, EUR: 1.17, USD: 1.29). Could cause CardServ to reject if amount is outside acceptable range.
likelyErrorScenarios.notes: Exchange rates in sale/route.ts are static, not live market rates

likelyErrorScenarios.scenario: Tokens credited but user not notified
likelyErrorScenarios.description: Payment was APPROVED and tokens were credited, but email confirmation failed. The user thinks payment failed because they didn't receive confirmation, while tokens were actually added.
likelyErrorScenarios.notes: Email errors are caught and logged but don't affect token crediting

Handle 3DS redirect return and finalize payment

transactions.purpose: Get all transactions for authenticated user

knownIssues.issue: No retry mechanism for failed webhooks
knownIssues.description: If CardServ webhook delivery fails, there is no retry or polling fallback. Orders can get stuck in PENDING/PROCESSING indefinitely.
knownIssues.recommendation: Add a cron job or scheduled task to poll CardServ status for orders stuck in PENDING/PROCESSING for more than 15 minutes

knownIssues.description: All logging uses console.log/console.error which is ephemeral in serverless environments. Logs are lost after function execution unless captured by an external service.
knownIssues.recommendation: Integrate a structured logging service (e.g., Vercel Log Drains, Sentry, or Datadog) to persist and query logs

knownIssues.description: Both /api/cardserv/webhook and /api/cardserv/result can credit tokens. The check (creditedTokens === 0) is not atomic — if webhook and result callback fire simultaneously, tokens could be credited twice.
knownIssues.recommendation: Use MongoDB findOneAndUpdate with { creditedTokens: 0 } as a condition to make the check-and-update atomic

knownIssues.description: Currency conversion uses hardcoded rates (EUR: 1.17, USD: 1.29 per GBP). These do not reflect live market rates and could cause pricing discrepancies.
knownIssues.recommendation: Use a live exchange rate API or update rates regularly

knownIssues.issue: No idempotency key for sale requests
knownIssues.description: If the client retries a failed /api/cardserv/sale request, a duplicate PaymentOrder is created with a new orderMerchantId. User could be charged twice.
knownIssues.recommendation: Accept a client-generated idempotency key and check for existing orders before creating a new one
